editorial.blurb: A lively corner bar near Wrigleyville with solid comfort food, excellent fries, and a fun crowd perfect for catching games and trivia nights.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit up $10 wrap Mondays for chicken Caesar or buffalo wraps, or come by for Taco Tuesday—and always order a side of fries, they're worth it on their own.

topDishes.note: among the best in the Midwest
solid choice, though could use more sauce
